paper_id: Wang et al. - 2015 - Disco Improving Packet Delivery via Deliberate Synchronized Constructive Interference
title: Disco: Improving Packet Delivery via Deliberate Synchronized Constructive Interference
venue: IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems
motivation: 传统CI(Constructive Interference)不能保证功率增益和PRR提升,WSN节点能量受限需更高效并发传输
problem_framing: 设计足够条件使多个并发传输在接收端产生正向叠加增益,而非仅容忍碰撞
key_insight: 精确补偿传播时延和无线电处理时延+链路选择对齐,可将CI从容忍碰撞提升为构造性叠加
method_signature: Triggercast: CLS(芯片级同步)+LSA(链路选择对齐)双模块分布式中间件
evaluation_criteria: PRR提升幅度(5→70%)、RSSI增益、同步误差(95th≤250ns)、ETX降低
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Glossy因未补偿传播时延且未选链路,性能甚至差于单路径路由
evidence_for_taste: no obvious power gain if RSSI differences exceed 3 dB
PRR drops quickly as differences of propagation delay increase
exactly synchronized signals with different link qualities might also superpose destructively
capture effect dominates the packet reception
more senders may not lead to PRR improvement
thinking_moves: 从实验发现传统CI无法保证功率增益→挑战已有工作假设
对现象建立理论充分条件(SC-I/II)再实现系统
把同步问题分解为传播时延补偿+无线电处理时延补偿两部分
cites_own_work: Exploiting constructive interference for scalable flooding (Wang et al., 2012 IEEE INFOCOM)
